subject: E-5292: upload stalls on macOS
body:
Hi, I'm using CourierOS 3.5.0 on macOS 15.3. Since last
week, every time I upload a file, I get 'E-5292: upload
stalled at 0 bytes/s'.

The machine's power profile was switched to the battery-
saver preset. Uploads stall as soon as the screen turns off.

I've already tried waiting a day, which changed nothing.

Regards, Omar Haddad, Brightwater Clinics
